subject: physics
title: Смешивание толуола
statement: There are $300$ cm$^3$ toluene of $0^\circ$C temperature in a glass and $110$ cm$^3$ toluene of $100^\circ$C temperature in another glass. (The sum of the volumes is $410$ cm$^3$.) Find the final volume after the two liquids are mixed. The coefficient of volume expansion of toluene $\beta = 0.001\ (^\circ\text{C})^{-1}$. Neglect the loss of heat.
